description: This file defines a PHP class 'Information' which is a controller for the 'information' module in the OpenCart catalog extension. It includes a method 'index' that loads language and model data, prepares an informational list including links, and renders a view template.

classes.name: Information
classes.description: A controller class for the 'information' module in the OpenCart catalog extension.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Prepares a list of information entries and other links, then renders the 'information' view.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads language and model, gathers information entries, constructs associated URLs, and returns a rendered view.
